items.headline: Max Johnson throws 4 TD passes, adds 1 on the ground as Georgia Southern pounds Marshall 49-13
items.description: — Max Johnson threw four touchdown passes, two to Jeremiah Ware, and ran for a score as Georgia Southern rolled to a 49-13 win over Marshall on Saturday night.

items.headline: Lester scores twice, Diaz Nicholas kicks 5 FGs, Marshall controls Old Dominion 36-23
items.description: — TJ Lester ran for two touchdowns, Jorge Diaz Nicholas made a school-record five field goals and Marshall turned four turnovers into 20 points en route to a 36-23 win over Old Dominion on Saturday.
